tests.title: Two prepared checkouts can place orders for the last available unit
tests.goal: Two prepared checkouts can place separate orders for the same last available unit, with the extra quantity recorded as a pre-order and available stock allowed to become negative.
preconditions: A stock-tracked, non-quota product with Pre-order disabled, exactly 1 available unit in the warehouse serving Online Shop, and zero units elsewhere
Two independent browser sessions with separate cookies and empty carts
data: Different guest details and unique emails for the two shoppers

steps.text: In both sessions, add 1 unit of the same product to the cart.
In both sessions, fill all checkout details, select store pickup and Bank Transfer, and accept the terms.
Submit session A and wait for its order confirmation.
Submit session B from its already-prepared checkout.
In the CRM, search orders by the product name and inspect inventory for the order warehouse.
Void both test orders and empty both carts.

expected.text: Both sessions reach order confirmation with different order numbers.
The CRM shows two orders, each with quantity 1 of the selected product.
Available quantity may reach -1 with Stock Qty 1 and Pre-order Qty 1; this is accepted even when the product Pre-order setting is disabled.
After both orders are voided, Available Qty and Stock Qty return to 1, Pre-order Qty returns to 0, and both carts are empty.

notes: User-reported result and acceptance decision: user reproduced both prepared checkouts succeeding without near-simultaneous submission, accepted the behavior as wont-fix, and requested this case pass. Recorded against revised accepted-behavior expectations. No fresh execution or cleanup was performed by Aside; user did not supply order IDs, timing, inventory measurements or cleanup evidence. Original independently observed failed run 2026-10-30_1557_staging_manual is unchanged.
